description: Validate a W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) document against the 2025.10 spec: token types, colour objects and their component ranges, dimensions, references, and property-level $ref pointers. Returns valid plus the list of errors with the path each one sits at. Pure and synchronous, no browser. Use it after writing or editing a token file, including one this server produced, so a hand edit cannot quietly break the document.

tokens.description: The DTCG token document to validate, as an object

name: validate_dtcg
